profile.primary_purpose: Drive pre-orders for the Ghost Core personal AI computer by communicating its key differentiators: local processing, privacy-first design, and proactive intelligence
profile.brand_signature: A premium, dark-mode aesthetic with cinematic product photography set against deep void backgrounds transitioning to light paper textures. Bold uppercase typography and electric blue accents create a high-tech yet approachable feel, while subtle blur effects and gradient overlays convey cutting-edge sophistication.

visual_language.accent_strategy: Electric blue (#006ddf) used for CTAs, interactive elements, and feature tags against dark void and light paper backgrounds. Vibrant orange (#ff5517) reserved for urgent announcements and product highlights.
visual_language.highlights: Soft blur and glow effects around product imagery, gradient overlays transitioning from dark to light sections, scanline textures for tech atmosphere

target_audience: Privacy-conscious tech enthusiasts seeking AI assistance without cloud dependency
Early adopters willing to invest $3,499 in cutting-edge personal computing hardware
Professionals and consumers concerned about data ownership who want intelligent automation on their own terms
strategy.executive_synthesis: Ghost positions the Core as a paradigm shift in personal AI—local intelligence that builds continuous context without subscription fees or cloud surveillance. The visual design mirrors this philosophy: dark, controlled environments give way to warm lifestyle imagery, signaling that powerful technology can integrate seamlessly into daily life. The premium price point and bold 'Order Now' CTA target affluent early adopters ready to own their digital intelligence rather than rent it.

style_classification.reasoning: The screenshot reveals a highly disciplined, grid-based design with dramatic contrast between dark navy/black (#00050A) and warm off-white/paper backgrounds (#EAE9E7) - the warm paper tone is a classic Swiss Style marker, not pure white. The layout profile confirms "generous_whitespace" and "centered_symmetric" classification with a strict 12-column grid system (1512px max-width). Typography is dominated by Archivo, a geometric sans-serif in light weights (200-400), with tight tracking and uppercase treatments - directly aligning with Swiss Style's obsession with typographic clarity and geometric type. The design exhibits extreme restraint: headline "Intelligence you own." uses clean flush-left alignment, body text is minimal, and the asymmetric two-column split (text/visual) echoes Swiss poster conventions. The texture profile reveals linear gradients and subtle noise/grain for paper authenticity, while maintaining flat, 2D dimensionality. The color palette is essentially monochromatic with strategic accent colors (blue CTA #006DDF, orange accent #FF5517) - precision accent deployment typical of Swiss objectivity. The massive black spacer section creates rhythmic pause through negative space, a Swiss composition technique. Section transitions via full-bleed color changes without visible dividers demonstrate grid discipline over decorative elements.
style_classification.reasoning_secondary: The Corporate modifier applies due to the technology/AI product context ("Intelligence you own"), professional tone, and trust-building visual language. The geometric sans-serif typography, muted color palette with strategic blue CTAs, and generous whitespace all serve to communicate competence, reliability, and sophistication. The glass panel effects (backdrop-filter: blur with rgba overlays) and sophisticated gradient systems elevate it beyond raw Swiss Style into polished corporate tech territory. The orange accent bar at top serves as brand identity anchor - a corporate signature element. Overall the design balances Swiss typographic rigor with contemporary corporate tech aesthetics.

layout.section_separation: Dramatic alternating backgrounds: dark navy/black (#00050a) for hero and feature sections contrast with light textured paper background (rgb(234, 233, 231)) for product and technical content. Large black spacer section creates strong rhythmic pause mid-page. Sections transition via full-bleed color changes with no visible dividers or rules.

insights: Layout operates at scale extremes: massive single-viewport hero sections (100dvh+) alternate with dense technical grids, creating dramatic vertical rhythm and scroll-triggered reveals.

Spatial hierarchy privileges negative space over density — each major content block occupies full viewport height, allowing single concepts to breathe and anchoring user attention through scroll-based animation choreography.

Compositional strategy centers on asymmetric 50/50 splits (text/visual) that flip orientation between sections, maintaining visual interest while preserving generous margins (64px+ from viewport edges) and consistent alignment grid (1512px max-width centered canvas).

paragraphs.description: Body text, notifications, and descriptive passages.

labels.description: UI navigation, component badges, labels, and micro-copy.

typography.highlights: Heavy use of CSS compositing for typography, including `<feTurbulence>` noise filters applied as background-image clippings on text, mix-blend-modes (mix-blend-plus-lighter), and duplicate layered DOM text elements with varying `blur()` radii to create glowing, "soft focus" typographic halos. Extreme tight tracking is applied to large display text (`tracking-[-1.1px]`, `tracking-[-0.04em]`). Almost all UI components and display headings force `uppercase`.
insights: Distinct Typographic Roles: The system clearly divides typography into 'font-display' (Archivo) for large, tight-tracked, emotional messaging, and 'font-ui' (Archivo Narrow) for sharp, uppercase navigation, buttons, and technical tags.

Experimental Rendering Techniques: Ghost.ai uses techniques usually reserved for images—like SVG noise filters applied via background-image, backdrop-filters, and multi-layered blurred DOM elements—to create rich, atmospheric text treatments directly in CSS.

Aggressive Fluidity & Tight Fitting: There is heavy reliance on fluid `clamp()` values and extreme negative letter-spacing for large text, ensuring that the brand’s technical aesthetic is maintained perfectly across diverse viewport sizes.
